workload.pattern: 16x16 subapertures of 16x16 px, one Gaussian spot (sigma 1.5 px) each
workload.timer: process CPU time per frame, blocks of 30 calls

in_process_ab_method: same process, old and new apply_gain_stage swapped in alternately, 15 interleaved blocks of 30 frames, best block
bit_identity: seeded frame and truth SHA-256 digests identical for every case; additionally every preset x {double, single} at 48x64 over two fluxes and three seeds (x86, NumPy 2.2.6)
